sentences.text: JSL Konsultointi Oy is a company registered on 2026-08-22 under the industry code 71121, engineering design and technical consultancy.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-22, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-30.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the record shows a consultancy and nothing about an ocean use.
